title: Where I have shipped real things.

items.overview: UI Health manages healthcare and academic operations across multiple internal systems. Faculty, scheduling, registration, and departmental data need to stay accurate, synchronized, and usable for the people running those workflows every day.
responsibilities: Led frontend development while managing a junior engineer, owning technical decisions across a React and Redux institutional platform for scheduling, registration, faculty management, and real-time dashboards serving 100+ daily active users.
Built an event-driven sync pipeline with Node.js, Celery, and Redis across 5+ systems, processing 1000+ records weekly with 0 downstream errors.

Migrated 20+ legacy workflows across 20+ pages into React, adding ESLint and TypeScript rules while delivering WCAG-compliant interfaces for 300+ faculty and staff and achieving 100% CI/CD pipeline success.

Built 20+ reusable MUI components across two microfrontend applications, standardizing frontend architecture while improving scalability, maintainability, and performance through efficient data fetching and caching.
Shipped real-time Chart.js dashboards with memoization and lazy loading, eliminating render bottlenecks for department-facing operational views.
Used Claude Code for code generation, debugging, documentation, and navigating codebases while maintaining code quality and delivery speed.
Mentored a junior engineer through code reviews and pair programming while helping establish frontend development best practices.

items.overview: LPS Health is a cardiovascular health and wellness platform focused on preventive care, educational content, community engagement, and donations. The organization needed reliable digital workflows, so I led a full-cycle rebuild across frontend, backend, analytics, and deployment within a three-month internship.
responsibilities: Rebuilt a legacy product from scratch as the sole developer, shipping a React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL architecture independently in three months using GitHub Copilot.
Improved Lighthouse score from 40 to 80 and reduced page load time by 70% through lazy loading, image optimization, caching, and accessibility-focused frontend improvements.
Built a 10+ component design system across two brands, defining color tokens, spacing, and usage rules reused consistently across both platforms.
Designed and deployed secure REST API endpoints with pagination, caching, SQL query optimization, and rate limiting for event listings, donation workflows, and campaign pages.
Integrated Sentry for real-time error tracking, achieved 80% Jest coverage, and set up Netlify CI/CD for same-day hotfixes.

items.overview: Oracle Fusion Cloud builds enterprise applications that support large-scale business operations. I worked with Berkshire Hathaway Energy stakeholders across operational systems, Oracle Fusion modules, frontend components, middleware, and API integrations.
responsibilities: Collaborated directly with Berkshire Hathaway Energy stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify workflows, and translate business needs into production-ready enterprise solutions.

Architected and maintained a standalone REST API middleware service on OCI, coordinating data synchronization across 10+ enterprise integrations between BHE operational systems and Oracle Fusion Cloud.
Delivered 20+ enterprise-grade Oracle VBS/VBCS components with documented usage rules and design tokens, adopted across 4+ modules.
Reduced redundant development effort across cross-functional teams of 10 to 20 developers, QA engineers, and consultants by standardizing reusable component patterns.
Resolved 100+ production issues across frontend, middleware, and API layers during Agile Scrum cycles, restoring workflows with minimal disruption.
